title: Green Tree Tavern (Janis-Ziegler House)

buildingCutout.basis: Historic American Buildings Survey measured perimeter of the covered galleries.

terrainReference.basis: Sample on the building side of the street retaining wall. The original DEM is bilinearly resampled and the exposed basement follows the measured cross section.

identities.name: Green Tree Tavern (Janis-Ziegler House)
identities.address: 244 St. Mary's Road, Ste. Genevieve, Missouri, United States

mapIdentity.scope: National Park Service HABS MO-1104 measured site plan, main-floor plan and transverse section, tied to the Library of Congress survey coordinate.

note: The measured section distinguishes the raised gallery level, exposed limestone basement and flared gambrel-like gable with shallow outer slopes. The surveyed long northeast facade and wrapped northwest end retain painted gallery framing. The exposed structural walnut sits behind the painted trim.
